title: ESQL: Fix version test failure on non-SNAPSHOT builds

timeline.message:
Fix version test failure on non-SNAPSHOT builds

Test the snapshot ESQL version separately and take the current build
into account.
timeline.author: Alexander Spies

timeline.body:
Fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/107106

Test the snapshot ESQL version separately and take the current build into account.

I _think_ the way to "skip" a test if some condition is not met is to use `assumeTrue`.

`assumeTrue("Should not test snapshot version here", version != EsqlVersion.SNAPSHOT)`

reply.body: Please, ignore my comment. With this approach the test will always be skipped.
